sections.Profile:
"Oklahoma" is a four-player electro-mechanical pinball machine released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in February 1961. Designed by Wayne Neyens with artwork by Roy Parker, the game features two flippers, four pop bumpers, two slingshots, two ball kickers, and two roto-targets.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1961
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 4
